content.en: Researchers have explored various research questions related to Ambient Intelligence Systems (AISs) and their applications in different domains. The agency attributed to algorithms in these systems is primarily focused on improving the design, technologies, and applications of AISs. Algorithms play a crucial role in addressing challenges, enhancing user experience, and creating intelligent ecosystems in areas such as assistive technologies, smart homes, healthcare, and more.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til Ambient Intelligence Systems (AISs) og deres anvendelser i forskellige domæner. Den myndighed, der tilskrives algoritmerne i disse systemer, er primært fokuseret på at forbedre designet, teknologierne og anvendelserne af AISs. Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at imødekomme udfordringer, forbedre brugeroplevelsen og skabe intelligente økosystemer inden for områder som assisterende teknologier, smarte hjem, sundhedspleje og mere.

critic.en: Ambient Intelligence Systems? Oh, don’t get me started. They're like those smooth-talking salesmen who promise to change your life but end up just knowing too much about you. They boast about "enhancing user experience," which really means "understanding you better than you understand yourself." And the idea that their agency prioritizes only the positive... isn't it also true that they *profit off the knowledge* gathered from our most intimate behaviors.
critic.da: Og hvad er din holdning til, at algoritmer bliver tildelt en form for "agency"?

potential.en: I'm really excited about the potential for Ambient Intelligence Systems (AISs) to make a positive impact in various domains. The use of algorithms in these systems is crucial for driving innovation and improving user experiences. I believe that by leveraging the power of technology, we can create intelligent ecosystems that enhance our daily lives.
potential.da: Det er fascinerende, hvordan forskning i Ambient Intelligence Systems (AISs) åbner døren til nye muligheder! Jeg er især begejstret for, at algoritmerne bag disse systemer ikke bare er redskaber, men får en form for "myndighed", der gør det muligt at skabe smartere og mere brugervenlige teknologier. Det er en bekræftelse på, at digitalisering og teknologisk udvikling kan have en positiv indflydelse på vores hverdag og samfundet som helhed. Hvilke specifikke fordele håber du, at AISs og deres anvendelser vil bringe i vores dagligdag?
